# Grammar-reachable XPath 1.0 semantics that testdata/expressions.txt does not happen to
# exercise. GENERATED answers: gen/XPathOracle.java writes semantics-kat.txt from these against
# semantics-fixtures/, exactly as it writes kat.txt from expressions.txt against fixtures/.
#
# expressions.txt is the upstream inventory and stays pure: it is what DSS can hand the engine,
# and nothing else. But the grammar this package accepts is slightly larger than that inventory
# in ways that follow from the grammar rather than from a choice - "=" between two node-sets is
# admitted the moment "=" and location paths both are - and those corners are conversion rules
# (clause 3.4) and string-values (clause 5) that are easy to get subtly wrong. Rather than
# assert what Xalan does from memory, they are pinned by the same oracle.
#
# Namespace context: namespaces.txt, the same one the inventory uses.

## node-set = node-set: existential over BOTH sides, comparing string-values
//a[@x=@y]
//a[@x=@z]
//a[@y=@z]
//nested[text=text]

## node-set = string: existential over the set
//a[@x='1']
//a[@x='3']
//empty[@e='']
//empty[@e='x']

## string-value of an element is the concatenation of its text descendants
//text[.='value']
//cdata[.='value']
//mixed[.='onetwo']
//mixed[.='one']
//blank[.='   ']
//nothing[.='']
//r[.=.]

## boolean conversion: a node-set is true when non-empty, a string when non-empty
//*[not(@x)]
//*[not(@nosuch)]
//*[.='']
//*[not(.='')]
//*[not(not(@x))]

## local-name() of the context node, which is "" for a node with no name
//*[local-name()='a']
//*[local-name()='named']
//*[local-name()='']
//*[local-name()='a' or local-name()='named']

## node tests over the child axis
//mixed/text()
//mixed/node()
//cdata/text()
//nothing/node()
//r/child::node()

## the attribute axis under a namespace: @q is the unprefixed one only
//*[@q='v']
//*/@q
//*/@ds:q

## conversions between the non-node-set types, and local-name() of an unnamed node
//r/child::node()[local-name()='']
//r/child::node()[local-name()='text']
//*[@x=not(@nosuch)]
//*[@x=not(@x)]
//*[not(@x)=not(@nosuch)]
//*[not(@x)='a']
//*['a'=not(@x)]
//*[local-name()=local-name()]
//*['a'='a']
//*['a'='b']
